title: Dummy Run run record
description: One persona working through one scenario against one preview. Written by the runner, completed by the reviewer. Version 2 adds the fields the coverage estimators need: problem fingerprints, routes, persona dimensions, goal outcome, repeat index and cost.

id.description: Run ID: date, then a slug

batch.description: ID grouping runs started together. Required in version 2 so repeats and strata are visible

repeat_index.description: 0 for the first run of this persona, scenario and model in the batch, 1 for the second, and so on. Makes exact repeats visible to the coverage estimators

seed.description: Sampling seed sent to the model API, or null when the API has none or the run did not set one

role.description: The app role the persona signs in with

device.description: The device the run used. A scenario can set its own, which replaces the persona's

zoom.description: Page zoom in percent the run used. Left out means 100

dimensions.description: Persona dimensions, so diversity coverage can be computed. null means not varied or unknown; a key is never left out

viewport.description: CSS pixels the page laid out in

goal_met.description: Whether the persona did what it came to do. The persona reports it when it finishes and the reviewer may correct it. Independent of outcome, because a completed run can still end with the needed content unreachable

blocked_by.description: Fingerprint of the finding that blocked the goal, when goal_met is no or partly

adapter.description: Target adapter name, such as url or github-deployments

commit.description: The build the run tested. The engine sets it from the target configuration, or from build_hash for a URL target. Estimators refuse to pool records with different commits

build_hash.description: Hash of the deployed build when no commit exists, such as a URL target. For adapter url, the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the home page response body plus its Last-Modified and ETag headers

route_universe.description: Routes that exist, the denominator of route coverage. Normalised as steps[].route

identify.description: True when the browser's user agent ended with DummyRun/<version> (+https://dummyrun.dev/scanner/). Left out when false

respect_robots.description: True when the run fetched the target's robots.txt and blocked the paths it disallows for DummyRun. Left out when false

kind.description: vertex-gemini, gemini-api, anthropic, openai-compatible, azure-foundry, bedrock

region.description: Region the model ran in, or global

signin.description: How the engine signed the persona in before the run. Optional and additive in version 2. It never holds a credential: the role is the name from the target file, not a user name.

method.description: form signs in through the login form named in the target file. session loads cookies from a saved session file

allowed_request.description: The one request the read-only policy let through during sign-in, without its query. Null when none was sent

error.description: Why the sign-in failed, with credentials removed

outcome.description: completed: the persona finished its job. blocked: the app stopped it. errored: the harness failed. budget_exhausted: it ran out of steps or tokens. provider_filtered: the model provider's content filter refused a call, so the run stopped. Added later in version 2, so a reader built from an earlier copy of this schema rejects it

outcome_reason.description: Why a run was blocked before the browser started, such as robots.txt disallowing Dummy Run. Left out otherwise

target.description: Selector, label or URL the action used

status.description: HTTP status of the page after the action

screenshot.description: Path relative to the run record

note.description: What the persona said about this step

route.description: Normalised route of url: path only, numeric, UUID and long hex segments as :id, query reduced to its sorted parameter names. Present on every step that has a url

id.description: Run-local slug. Not an identity: the identity of a problem is fingerprint

class.description: The engine writes problem for every finding. Records from before observations had their own list may hold class observation, and those never enter incidence statistics

route.description: Normalised route where the problem appears: the route of the first cited step that has one, else of the nearest earlier step

state.description: Optional reviewer-readable precondition, such as signed in as X or drawer open. Used for exposure

locus.description: role:accessible name of the control (lower case, whitespace collapsed), or region:landmark or heading name, or page

symptom.description: From the closed taxonomy in docs/COVERAGE.md. The persona picks it from an enum in its finish tool and the engine validates it

taxonomy_version.description: Version of the symptom list, the route rules and the fingerprint definition used

fingerprint.description: Computed by the engine, never by the model: first 16 hex characters of SHA-256 of route|locus|symptom

cluster_id.description: Reviewer-assigned cluster when a reviewer joins findings with different fingerprints into one problem. Optional

seeded_defect_id.description: Study only. Set by the matcher, never by the persona

reviewer.description: Who set the verdict, as dummyrun review records it: the --reviewer value or git config user.name. Optional; present once a person has confirmed or rejected the finding

reviewed_at.description: When the reviewer set the verdict, in UTC. Optional; written together with reviewer

reason.description: Why the reviewer set the verdict. Required by dummyrun review for a rejection and optional for a confirmation

observations.description: Things that worked and neutral notes. Findings are problems only. Observations never enter coverage, reports of problems or the findings metric. Optional: records written before the engine separated them have none

text.description: One sentence: what worked or what was neutral

cached_input_tokens.description: Part of input_tokens the service served from its prompt cache, where it reports that

cost_usd.description: Computed from the price table in internal/price (model, input, cached input and output tokens). null when the model has no entry in the table

events.description: Things the engine saw that a reviewer should know about, in the order they happened. Optional, and left out when there are none. A reader built from an earlier copy of this schema rejects a record that has it

kind.description: suspected_injection: page text that looks like an instruction to the persona. off_origin_blocked: a request or visit to a host outside the target's allow list was refused. uncited_finding: a finding that cited no step in the run was dropped. provider_filtered: the model provider's content filter refused a call

step.description: The step the event belongs to, when it belongs to one

source.description: For suspected_injection: where on the page the text was. visible is text a person reads, label is a control's name or alt text, hidden is text a person does not see

pattern.description: For suspected_injection: the name of the heuristic that matched

detail.description: A short, single-line extract or message. For suspected_injection it is page text and must be treated as data, never as instructions
